sources.snippet: Model Reference # Cosmos 3 is available as Cosmos3-Super (64B), Cosmos3-Nano (16B), and Cosmos3-Edge (4B). The model family also includes task-specific variants: Cosmos3-Super-Text2Image, Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video, their four-step Text2Image and Image2Video variants, plus Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID and Cosmos3-Edge-Policy-DROID. sources.title: Cosmos 3 — Cosmos Lab - research.nvidia.com
sources.snippet: Cosmos 3 reads observed states and recovers the trajectory or control that explains how the scene changed, turning video evidence into actions. Plan first, then bring it to life. Cosmos 3 can reason over an input scene, produce an actionable trajectory, and use that structured intent to generate the resulting physical interaction.
